notes.title: Thank you
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone that has supported Don’t Disturb!
First of all, we would like to thank you for purchasing the game. We’ve been closely paying attention to the feedback you have provided and we humbly accept all the good and bad. We are sincerely sorry that some of you may have encountered some technical issues. We will try to do our best to improve the gameplay following the feedback we have received.

Regarding the puzzles here are two hints for you:
1.	In order to move on to the next puzzle, please collect all the gold coins.
2.	You will have to collect FIVE (5) cards to activate the card puzzle. 

The above two hints will be added to the game and we will do everything we can to fix bugs shortly . Thanks again for your feedback!

tags.feature: The above two hints will be added to the game

tags.bug: we will do everything we can to fix bugs shortly
